Game Overview

In Escape in 180, the core idea is straightforward: race against the clock in Escape in 180, a thrilling platformer that challenges you to conquer each level within three minutes. Navigate twisting paths, activate switches, and collect coins while racing for the exit door. Speed and precision are your allies—hesitate, and the clock will claim victory.
